data.name: Kshirabdhi
data.gender_notes: Kshirabdhi is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Hindu mythology, Kshirabdhi is the Ocean of Milk, the source of all creation. The name Kshirabdhi carries the meaning “Ocean of Milk” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Kshirabdhi usually hope their child will grow to embody ocean of milk and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes nourishment, abundance, and life's origins.
data.etymology: Kshirabdhi belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Ocean of Milk.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kshirabdhi total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
